# Architectural Digest

> Architectural Digest is the premier source for luxury home design, celebrity architecture, and interior design inspiration.

Architectural Digest covers high-end residential design, celebrity homes, architecture trends, and lifestyle content. The site serves both design enthusiasts and professionals through editorial content, video tours, magazine features, and a membership directory for design professionals.

## Key Topics

- Celebrity Homes
- Interior Design
- Architecture
- Luxury Real Estate
- Home Tours
- Design Inspiration
- Home Décor
- Designer Profiles
- Lifestyle
- Design Professionals
- Los Angeles
- New York City
- Modern Architecture
- Home Design Trends
- AD Magazine

## Celebrity Homes & Real Estate

- [Celebrity Homes: Style and Design](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/celebrity-style): Celebrity homes, luxury real estate tours, and celebrity interior design features.
- [Real Estate](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/real-estate): Celebrity real estate, luxury homes, and mansion features and property showcases.
- [Melanie Lynskey and Jason Ritter's LA Home](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/story/melanie-lynskey-and-jason-ritters-la-home-martin-and-brockett): Celebrity home tour: Melanie Lynskey and Jason Ritter's LA residence design.

## Magazine & Publishing

- [AD Magazine: Celebrity Covers, Subscriptions, and More](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/magazine): AD magazine covers, subscriptions, celebrity features, and designer profiles.
- [Architectural Digest Homepage](https://www.architecturaldigest.com): Architectural Digest homepage featuring celebrity homes, design inspiration, and architecture.

## Architecture & Design News

- [Architecture and Design News](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/architecture-design): Architecture and design news, trends, and designer profiles from Architectural Digest.
- [Lifestyle - Travel, Entertaining and Art News](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/culture-lifestyle): Lifestyle guides covering travel, design inspiration, art, and luxury living.

## Video Content

- [Video](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/video): Video series featuring celebrity home tours, architecture, and interior design.

## Design Resources & DIY

- [AD It Yourself](https://www.architecturaldigest.com/ad-it-yourself): DIY home design advice, projects, and home improvement tips from AD experts.
